_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.py builds this example from the skill's assets/. host = 'blank' because the skill's output is a Document Type's template plus the C# that renders it, and the blank host gives the example its own productPage type with no starter-kit templates competing for the route; it also compiles Razor at runtime, which is how the installed .cshtml files are served. namespace = what <Namespace> becomes. assets = every file the skill ships — the building blocks don't conflict, so one example covers them all. requires = the content this example seeds and needs in order to prove anything.
